title: Pork shoulder "ribs"
instructions: Double butterfly the pork shoulder into a flat 1-1.5in thick uniform long strip
Mustard + rub all over. Season with salt and pepper both sides
Cover tightly aluminum foil in a casserole dish or pan.
Transfer to clean sheet pan, broil on high for 2 mins each side
Coat top side with sauce, broil for 2 mins. Coat bottom side with sauce, broil 2 min or until caramelized.
